name: Ikoi
description:
An ADHD task manager

Gentle productivity for busy brains
One tiny first step per task. A list that matches your energy. No overdue red, no guilt pile.

	Brain dump
		Get it out of your head, fast
		Type the mess in your head. Ikoi turns each thought into its own task, first step already written.

	Energy matching
		How’s your battery today?
		Tell Ikoi how you feel. It filters your day to match.

	Task decay
		"Not today" isn’t failure
		Tap "Not today" and a task quietly steps off your plate. Not "I failed" but "I chose."

Tasks you never touch fade a little each day, then archive themselves. Archived, not deleted.

__________________

And the rest
Small features, low friction
Every one of these exists because a generic app failed us first.

	Body-doubling timer
	A focus timer with an optional companion

	"Oh wait…" capture
	Dump a stray thought, sort it later

	Calendar & reminders
	Events beside tasks, gentle nudges, two-way sync

	Schedule by feel
	Plan by part of day, not rigid clock slots

	Make it yours
	Themes, icon sets, and fonts to match your vibe

	Offline-first
	Works with no account and no connection

__________________
